tha-ap23:1.1: himavantassāvidūre → himavantassa avidūre (bj); paṭhamaṁ subhūtittherāpadānaṁ himavantassa avidūre (sya-all)

tha-ap23:5.4: damemahaṁ rajjase rajjanīye → dammehaṁ rajjasi rajanīye (bj) | ekaggo → ekako (sya-all)
tha-ap23:6.2: dussanīye → dosanīye (bj, sya-all) | dussase → dussasi (bj) | dussasi → dussase (bj: the, machasaṁ)
tha-ap23:8.2: puttaṁ → yuttaṁ (sya-all) | yuttaṁ → yadā puttaṁ (bj: machasaṁ, the) | puttaṁ → sadāyuttaṁ (cck: sī.); yadāyuttaṁ (cck: syā.)
tha-ap23:10.2: gihī nāpi → gihi napi (sya-all) | saññato → gihinā nāpi paññatto (bj: PTS)
tha-ap23:11.2: pajānāti → pajāni hi (sya-all) | te → ko pajānihi te (bj: PTS, sī.selu)
tha-ap23:11.3: vahisi me → jahasi te (bj) | saddhādhuraṁ → sīghaṁ dhuraṁ (sya-all) | jahasi → pāhisi (bj: PTS); vahasi (bj: machasaṁ); pahāsi (bj: the); piṅgadūraṁpahisi (bj: sī.selu) | te → me (bj note) | vahisi → saddhādhuraṁ jahasi (cck: sī.); sīghaṁ dhuraṁ vahisi (cck: syā.)
tha-ap23:13.4: jīvihisi → jīvissasī (bj); jīvihisī (sya-all) | jīvissasī → jīvāhisi (bj: sī.selu, machasaṁ); jivihisi (bj: PTS, the) | jīvihisi → jīvissasi (cck: sī.)
tha-ap23:14.1: pabhinnaṁ mātaṅgaṁ → pabhinnamātaṅgaṁ (bj) | tidhā pabhinnaṁ → tidhappabhinnaṁ (sya-all)
tha-ap23:15.4: pavedhati → pavadheti (bj) | pajjhāyanto → ujjhā (bj: PTS) | pavadheti → padhācati (bj: PTS)
tha-ap23:17.4: yūthāva → yuthāva (bj) | nissaṭo → yuthā vinissaṭo (bj: aṭṭhakathā, sīmu)
tha-ap23:18.2: jhāyati → yāyati (sya-all) | jhāpeti → jhāyati. yāyati (bj: PTS) | jhāyati → yāyati (cck: syā.)
tha-ap23:18.4: jhāyissasi → yāyissasi (sya-all) | jhāpessasi → nevayāsi (PTS); jhāyissasi (bj note) | jhāyissasi → yārissati (cck: syā.)
tha-ap23:20.1: sayaṁ → sakaṁ (sya-all) | sayaṁ → sakaṁ (bj: PTS, sī.selu)
tha-ap23:22.4: vipine → pavane (sya-all) | atikkamuṁ appamādarataṁ → atikkamama appamādena maṁ (sya-all) | me → pavaneva me (bj: PTS, sī.selu); pavaneva (bj: the)
tha-ap23:25.2: vijjūvabbhaghanantare → vijjuvabbhaghanantare (sya-all) | vijjū’va’bbhaghanantare → vijjuva gaganantare (bj: the)
tha-ap23:26.3: lāsito byaggharājāva → lasito vyaggharājāva (bj) | lāsito → abhīto (sya-all) | lasito → dūrāsado (bj: the) | Lāsito → abhīto (cck: syā.)
tha-ap23:28.3: majjhanhikeva sūriyo → majjhantikeva suriyo (bj, sya-all) | majjhantikeva → kova (bj: PTS, sī.selu) | Majjhanhikeva → majjhantikeva (cck: sabbattha)
tha-ap23:29.1: nabhe → disvāna taṁ (bj: machasaṁ); disvāna taṁ nabhe (bj: the)
tha-ap23:31.4: sannipātesahaṁ → santipātetvahaṁ (bj) | santipātetva’haṁ → santipātesa’haṁ (bj: machasaṁ) | sannipātesahaṁ → sannipātetvāhaṁ (cck: sī.)
tha-ap23:33.2: tavanucchavaṁ → tavanucchaviṁ (bj); tavanucchakaṁ (sya-all) | tava’nucchaviṁ → nucchakaṁ (bj: sī.selu)
tha-ap23:41.2: dāse kammakare → dāsakammakare (sya-all) | dāse → pesa (bj: sī.selu)
tha-ap23:43.2: dakkhiṇeyyaguṇamhi → dakkhiṇeyyaguṇambhi (bj); dakkhiṇeyyagaṇamhi (sya-all) | taṁ → etadagge ṭhapessati (bj: the); ṇeyyaguṇehi (bj: machasaṁ)
tha-ap23:43.3: ca → vihārena (bj: machasaṁ); araṇavihāre dakkhiṇeyye (bj: the)
tha-ap23:43.4: agge → aggaṁ (sya-all) | ṭhapessati → dvīsu ṭhānesu gotamo (bj: the)
tha-ap23:44.2: jalajuttamanāmako → jalajuttaranāmako (bj); jalajuttamanāyako (sya-all) | jalajuttaranāmako → jalajuttamanāyako (bj: PTS, sī.selu)
tha-ap23:44.3: vīro → dhīro (bj) | abbhuggamī vīro → abbhuggami dhīro (sya-all)
